title: Gamma Ray Burst Photon-Level Dataset
purpose: Enable detailed temporal and spectral analysis of Gamma Ray Bursts at the photon level for research in high-energy astrophysics, transient phenomena characterisation, and understanding GRB emission mechanisms.

provenance.sources: Photon event data generated from GRB observations or simulations
provenance.processing: Photon events extracted with associated arrival times (relative to trigger) and energies. Data cleaned to remove spurious detections and calibrated for energy measurements.
provenance.derivations: Time coordinates referenced to GRB trigger time (t=0). Energy values calibrated and expressed in keV.

structure.conventions: TIME column represents seconds since GRB trigger (t=0). ENERGY values in kiloelectronvolts (keV). Each row represents one detected photon. Rows are grouped by origin_GRB identifier.
structure.relationships: Photons are grouped by origin_GRB identifier, allowing analysis of individual GRB events. Multiple photons share the same origin_GRB value.

quality.validation: Data validated for temporal ordering within each GRB event. Energy values checked for physical plausibility (positive values). GRB identifiers verified for consistency.

metrics.totalEvents: Multiple GRB events identified by unique origin_GRB values
metrics.energyRange: Positive values in MeV representing detected photon energies
metrics.temporalRange: Times relative to trigger, starting from t=0

limitations: Data represents photon-level information without additional metadata about instrumental response or background
Energy calibration accuracy depends on detector characteristics not explicitly encoded in this dataset
Temporal resolution limited by detector timing capabilities
No information on photon detection efficiency or selection criteria included
quality.usageGuidance: Suitable for time-resolved spectroscopy, light curve construction, timing analysis, and spectral studies of GRBs. Users should consider detector properties and potential selection effects when interpreting results. Recommended for research requiring photon-level temporal and spectral information.

access.reuseGuidance: Users must provide appropriate attribution when using or redistributing this dataset. No additional restrictions apply beyond proper citation.
